notes: Processed data generated for this paper (its Data availability statement). The paper reanalyzes a previously published data set (ref. 23, Widloski & Foster 2022; 37 sessions from 3 of its 4 rats), so the recordings are reused. The Zenodo file list has three replayEvents_*.mat files (events with cell-ID shuffles, ripple-field statistics, event statistics); event contents are inferred from file names, not opened, and raw LFP or spike inputs are not established. The separate Zenodo 15199609 deposit is code.

Yang dataset 1 reuses the Huszar 2022 mouse dataset. Published version 0.230630.2304 names Huszar et al. 2022 (10.1038/s41593-022-01138-x) as its describing publication and summarizes LFP, Units and Position among its variables (sources.md#dataset-catalog-checks); individual files and event annotations were not inspected.

Yang dataset 2 reuses the Achilles session. The CRCNS description lists spikes, position and epochs; see sources.md#grosmark-data for the archive inspection scope. This does not identify the independent LFP detector used by Yang.

The inspected release includes Data/e13_26m1_210913.rippleHSE.events.mat. Stored metadata names find_HSE but leaves detectionparms empty. Assignment of this example to original versus reused recordings is not established.

Metadata lists LFP, sorted spikes and tracking for many sessions; exact paper/session subset is not pinned. Harvey key resources identify this reused dataset. CRCNS downloads require an account; consult the deposit use conditions.

Metadata lists raw recordings, LFP, sorted spikes and tracking; exact paper/session subset is not pinned. Harvey key resources identify this reused dataset. CRCNS downloads require an account; consult the deposit use conditions.

Archive inspection is described in sources.md#grosmark-data; no documented original SWR/replay table established. Harvey key resources identify this reused dataset. CRCNS downloads require an account; consult the deposit use conditions.

Metadata lists LFP, sorted spikes, tracking and ripple .evt files. Those files were not inspected, and their identity with Harvey replay candidates is not established. Harvey key resources identify this reused dataset. CRCNS downloads require an account; consult the deposit use conditions.

Version 13 (Zenodo 7114733 mirror file list and README). Per session: extracted_CSC.mat (four downsampled, unfiltered channels chosen for theta, ripple, delta and low-ripple power), extracted_clusters.mat (spike times) and extracted_position.mat (tracks and sleep box). No event file is listed. The list has CSC for ten sessions but no RAT1_SESS2 CSC, a RAT4_SESS3 CSC without clusters or position, and RAT1_SESS2 clusters and position the same size as RAT4_SESS1's; check before use.

ZIP inventory of 1,310 entries inspected in the existing audit: raw Axona recordings; no separately named SWR/replay/candidate files found. Variables inside all MAT files were not inspected. The deposit identifies Olafsdottir 2016, rather than new Bush-specific data.

The Key Resources Table lists Grosmark et al. CRCNS 10.6080/K0862DC5 as deposited data; the paper uses it for the interneuron analysis (Fig. 7C-D), not for replay detection. See sources.md#grosmark-data for the deposit inspection. Account required; consult deposit use conditions.

Released with Widloski 2025, which cites its data set as this paper's (ref. 23). The replay events are the 2025 reanalysis, which does not require bursts or ripples, not this paper's event list; contents are inferred from file names only. Raw inputs are not established.

The paper's own deposit (version 5): ten W-track rats, nine of which contributed to earlier studies (Karlsson 2008, 2009; Carr 2012; Kay 2016, 2020), so most recordings are reused. The README describes LFP, sorted spikes and position per animal and the ripple-identification steps, ending in {animal}candripples{day}.mat after combining tetrodes. Tables were not opened. Zenodo 5587779 mirrors the ten animal archives.

The Dryad deposit's DataCite record declares hc-6 (10.6080/K0NK3BZJ) as its supplement. The hc-6 file-type list names no ripple files; the Dryad row carries the event tables. Exact animal/session overlap was not mapped. Account required; consult deposit use conditions.

Pinned published version. Landing metadata lists CA1 tetrode recordings, port/reward events and position; LFP, sorted-unit and ripple-table contents were not checked at the file level in this catalog pass.

Paper links data and analysis routines here. Existing audit inspected the API inventory and behavior/place-code notebooks; the code folder was empty and imported detector modules absent. Signal arrays and event inventories were not verified.
Version 1 landing page identifies original recordings from all rats in Igata et al.; it refers to readme.txt. Individual signals and event annotations were not inspected.

Complete ZIP listing and ReadMe/MetaData.docx inspected: one tetrode LFP, spikes, behavior and tracking. events.mat contains trial/delay/reward timing, not established SWR/replay annotations. Arrays were not exhaustively inspected. Automated article-page requests receive an AWS WAF challenge; the version-2 public API and all three file download links work (bounded byte-range checks; see source note).

Farooq Neuron uses Grosmark data for cross-validation with EMG-verified SWS. See sources.md#grosmark-data for the deposit inspection. This does not catalog the availability of Farooq original recordings.

Shin association comes from the existing paper note. Published version 0.240511.0307 describes Single Day W-Track Learning with LFP, CA1/PFC spike times and position for eight subjects (ER1, JS14, JS15, JS17, JS21, JS34, KL8, ZT2) and lists no related publication (sources.md#dataset-catalog-checks). Which subjects are the paper's was not checked. Complete file inventory and event-table absence remain unverified.

Author-released derived candidates on recordings reused from van der Meer et al. 2017. One actual Git LFS file, R050-2014-03-29-candidates.mat, was read: 1654 candidate intervals with stored configuration. This link is to event files, not the raw recording inputs; candidates are not final decoded replays.

The paper uses the dataset of van der Meer, Carey & Tanaka 2017 (paper note); the DataLad README names that paper and lists 4 rats with 6 sessions each: LFP (.ncs), spike trains (.t), position (.nvt) and metadata. The README and directory listings name no event files; the released candidate events are the separate GitHub row. Session folders were not opened.

The About page names this paper: 5 sessions of passive/active travel interleaved with sleep, with spikes, LFP at 1250 Hz and head positions in NeuroSuite format, plus analysis scripts. It does not say whether ripple .evt files are included; the archive was not opened. Account required; consult deposit use conditions.

Inert parsing of the nelpy 0.2.0 artifact established spikes, 457 MUA epochs and 277 final binned PBEs for session 16-40-19. These are different inventories; raw LFP availability and the recording original/reused relationship are not established here.

Paper note identifies the reused Karlsson W-maze data; CRCNS hc-6 includes that collection and other sessions. Exact session matching was not done. The published file-type list names no ripple table. The Denovellis 2021 Dryad re-release (10.7272/Q61N7ZC3) of Frank-lab W-track animals lists ripple tables, whose relation to published events is not established; see that row. Account required; consult deposit use conditions.

The paper's linear-track data are Diba & Buzsaki 2007 recordings (paper note), which hc-3 holds for rats gor01, pin01 and vvp01 (see the Diba row). Exact session mapping was not done. Account required; consult deposit use conditions.

The About page names Jadhav et al. 2016 and Tang et al. 2017. Three rats (HPa, HPb, HPc) on the W-track alternation task; whether these are all of the paper's animals was not checked. The data description lists position, clustered spikes, task, tetrode and cell information, and eeg (LFP filtered 1-400 Hz, one channel per tetrode), with no ripple files. Account required; consult deposit use conditions.

Description lists spikes, position and epochs. Related DANDI NWB conversion is cataloged separately; these are not independent datasets. No documented original SWR inventory or detector caller established by the inspection. CRCNS account required.

NWB conversion of CRCNS hc-11. HDF5 metadata inspected in all eight files: intervals contains epochs only, analysis is empty, processing contains behavior/ecephys. No SWR/replay interval table found in that scope; raw arrays were not exhaustively downloaded.
